messages:
hector_cs: FYI customer 'Atlas Analytics' flagged a month-end mismatch — invoice shows ~3,220,410 embedding tokens for Feb but dashboard export shows 2,132,980. They asked for a breakdown of line items and applied credits.

sara_billing: Ack — opening billing export now. Can you attach a sample request ID or timeframe? Might be related to a mid-cycle plan change we processed last week.

mike_engineer: Putting on my queue. If you can paste the invoice line items CSV row(s) I can join against request logs. Also need any request_ids the customer provided.

hector_cs: Customer gave these example request_ids: r_q3Yf8t, r_q3Yf8u (both Jan 31 / Feb 1 overlap window). They say most traffic was embeddings with an internal reranker hitting the same model (we might be double-matching).

sara_billing: Exported two invoice lines for the same model: "embeddings.standard" charge 1,850,000 tokens and "embeddings.rerank" charge 1,370,410 tokens. Dashboard export grouped both under "embeddings" and deduped rerank calls by session id, so sum differs.

mike_engineer: Interesting — our meter counts raw token events (token_count) per API call. The dashboard rollup pipeline deduplicates on session_id for UI clarity; invoice uses billing_events table which records each call. That could explain raw > dashboard. Can you confirm if the customer's reranker called the embeddings API separately or used batch/knn rerank path?

hector_cs: Customer says the reranker calls were separate POSTs to /v1/embeddings with same document set but different params (top_k vs vector-only). They expected dashboard grouping to combine them.

jen_ops: Possible root cause: plan change on 2026-02-15 at 03:12 UTC. When we applied the new tier, proration script created a mirrored billing_event for some calls flagged as 're-eval' and duplicated token rows for a subset of session_ids. That proration create job has a bug where it re-emits events when request timestamp < proration_cutoff and request had multiple meter_tags.

mike_engineer: Repro steps for ops/eng: 1) query billing_events where customer_id=atlas_123 and invoice_month='2026-02' and meter_tag in ('embeddings','rerank'); 2) group by request_hash and count >1 indicates duplicates; 3) cross-check request_logs by request_id for identical timestamps and payloads. SQL snippet: ```SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM billing_events WHERE customer_id='atlas_123' AND invoice_month='2026-02' AND meter_tag IN ('embeddings','rerank') GROUP BY request_id HAVING cnt>1;``` Please run and paste first 10 rows.

billing-bot: Billing export available: s3://redwood-exports/atlas_123/2026-02/invoice_4823/lines.csv

sara_billing: Ran the SQL — found ~1,369 request_ids with duplicate billing_events. Most duplicates are in the 02/01-02/20 window around the plan-change. Attaching narrowed CSV snippet => rows show identical token_count and meter_unit but different billing_event_id.

hector_cs: Shared this with customer and asked if they want us to issue a credit or adjust the invoice while we fix ingestion. They prefer a corrected invoice if root cause is on our side.

jen_ops: Action items: (1) disable proration re-emission job for now; (2) dedupe billing_events by (request_hash, invoice_month) during invoice generation; (3) prepare a reconciled invoice and propose credit for duplicated token rows. I'll open an ops ticket and include a rollback plan.

mike_engineer: I'll add a fix to the proration lambda to set a flag so it skips re-emitting when original_event exists. Quick patch and test on staging with sample events should catch this.

sara_billing: Noted. I'll withhold final invoice send for Atlas until reconciled. Hector — please ask the customer for patience and we'll follow up with a corrected invoice by EOD+2.

hector_cs: Will do, thx. :thumbsup:
